narr: A large mesoscale convective system formed over northern Mexico and moved north into Arizona. This feature produced severe weather in southern Arizona and a large haboob dust storm that tracked all the way into southern Yavapai County. The following thunderstorms progressed through northern Arizona and produced heavy rain and some flash flooding.
ev: A USGS stream gauge on Granite Creek (GCRA3) measured a 4.6 foot rise in 30 minutes. A CoCoRaHS observer upstream of the gauge confirmed water nearing a business parking lot in downtown Prescott. The observer measured 2.05 inches of rain.
